policy: Human SME review is independent external evidence. Automated QA may verify coverage, fingerprints/identity and review-record shape, but must never create or infer an SME approval.
validationRule: Validated requires one current human review record for every chapterId, all requiredDimensions explicitly passed or resolved, reviewerReference and reviewedAt present, and no unresolved safety/accuracy objection.
privacyBoundary: Use a non-sensitive reviewerReference. Do not publish personal contact details, employer/customer identifiers or proprietary mould/process information.
workedCaseReviewRule: Each workedCaseId must be reviewed inside its owning chapter across the same six requiredDimensions. A chapter approval for this release must include the worked case where present; automation must not create or infer that approval.
enrichmentReviewRule: Each enrichmentChapterId must be reviewed with all published evidence-enrichment sections in that chapter. Automation may verify scope and identity but must not create or infer human SME approval.
